Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left lane on a city street in Pasadena, Texas, when the vehicle operated by
Driver 2 entered the roadway from a private drive and struck the front of Driver 1's vehicle in a low-speed head-on
collision. Both vehicles sustained visible front-end damage. Driver 1 was seated in the driver's seat at the scene, and
a Passenger was also in the vehicle; both the responding officer and a witness confirmed their presence. Driver 1
reported neck and back strain and was evaluated by emergency medical personnel. The injuries reported are
consistent with the direction and force of the impact. Scene photographs confirm the general location of the vehicles
and the front-end damage, though no independent witnesses to the collision itself were identified. Based on the
available information, it is not clear whether all of the damage to Driver 1's vehicle resulted from this impact. No prior
damage to the vehicle is known to the reporting officer. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the insurance policy
covering the vehicle. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review.
</page>
